### LASSO

```{r}
tumors <- tumors %>%
  mutate(Class = factor(Class, ordered = FALSE))
```




```{r}
set.seed(494)
library(readr)
data11tumors2 <- read_csv("~/Desktop/stat_gen_2025/data/data11tumors2.csv")

split_index <-createDataPartition(data11tumors2$Class, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- data11tumors2[split_index, ]
test_data <- data11tumors2[-split_index, ]
```




```{r}



# Then split into training and test
set.seed(494)
set.seed(494)
library(readr)
tumors <- read_csv("~/Desktop/stat_gen_2025/data/data11tumors2.csv") 

split_index <-createDataPartition(tumors$Class, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
tumor_train <- read_csv("/Users/noahshannon/Desktop/Classes/STAT Gen/Presentation/train.csv")
test_data <- read_csv("/Users/noahshannon/Desktop/Classes/STAT Gen/Presentation/test.csv")
# How many rows total

tumor_train <- tumor_train %>%
  mutate(
    across(-Class, as.numeric),  # Make everything except Class numeric
    Class = as.factor(Class)      # Make Class a factor
  )

test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(-Class, as.numeric),  # Make everything except Class numeric
    Class = as.factor(Class)     # Make Class a factor
  )


# Now create folds from tumor_train (which has obs_id!)
tumor_folds <- vfold_cv(tumor_train, v = 5, strata = Class)

```


```{r}
lasso_spec <- multinom_reg(
  penalty = tune(),
  mixture = 1  # pure LASSO
) %>%
  set_engine("glmnet") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

```


```{r}
lasso_rec <- recipe(Class ~ ., data = tumor_train) %>%               # 🔥 remove 'set' column
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())


```

```{r}
lasso_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(lasso_rec) %>%
  add_model(lasso_spec)

```

```{r}
penalty_grid <- grid_regular(
  penalty(range = c(-4, 1)),  # 10^-4 to 10^1
  levels = 10
)

```


```{r}
tune_output <- tune_grid(
  lasso_wf,
  resamples = tumor_folds,
  grid = penalty_grid,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, mn_log_loss),
  control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
)

```

```{r}
autoplot(tune_output) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_math(10^.x)) +
  labs(
    x = "λ (Regularization Strength)",
    y = "Performance Metric",
    title = "LASSO Model Performance Across λ Values"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

```


```{r}
best_se_penalty <- select_by_one_std_err(
  tune_output,
  metric = "accuracy",
  desc(penalty)
)

```




```{r}
final_lasso_wf <- finalize_workflow(lasso_wf, best_se_penalty)

final_fit <- final_lasso_wf %>%
  fit(data = tumor_train)

```



```{r}
# Predict on tumor_test
preds <- predict(final_fit, new_data = test_data) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data)

# View predictions
head(preds)

```


```{r}
library(broom)

# Tidy the model coefficients
final_fit %>%
  extract_fit_parsnip() %>%
  tidy() %>%
  filter(estimate != 0)

```



```{r}
conf_mat(preds, truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class) %>%
  summary()

```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(yardstick)

# Step 1: Generate predictions from final LASSO model
# (Assumes your finalized workflow is `final_fit` and test set is `test_data`)
lasso_preds <- predict(final_fit, new_data = test_data) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data)

# Step 2: Create a clean dataframe for yardstick
lasso_preds_df <- lasso_preds %>%
  select(Class, .pred_class)

# Step 3: Ensure factor levels match
lasso_preds_df <- lasso_preds_df %>%
  mutate(
    Class = factor(Class),
    .pred_class = factor(.pred_class, levels = levels(Class))
  )

# Step 4: Compute metrics using yardstick
lasso_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, sens, spec)(lasso_preds_df, truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class)

# Step 5: Extract individual metrics
lasso_accuracy <- lasso_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "accuracy") %>% pull(.estimate)
lasso_sens     <- lasso_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "sens")     %>% pull(.estimate)
lasso_spec     <- lasso_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "spec")     %>% pull(.estimate)

# Step 6: Combine into summary table
lasso_summary <- tibble(
  Model = "LASSO",
  Accuracy = lasso_accuracy,
  Sensitivity = lasso_sens,
  Specificity = lasso_spec
)

# Step 7: View result
lasso_summary

```

### SVM

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(e1071)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
library(readr)
data11tumors2 <- read_csv("../data/data11tumors2.csv")
```



```{r}
# Features (X) and Target (y)
X <- data11tumors2 %>% select(starts_with("D"))
y <- data11tumors2$Class


# Train/Test split (80% train, 20% test)
set.seed(494)
train_indices <- sample(1:nrow(data11tumors2), 0.8 * nrow(data11tumors2))
X_train <- X[train_indices, ]
y_train <- y[train_indices]
X_test <- X[-train_indices, ]
y_test <- y[-train_indices]
```

```{r}
split_index <- createDataPartition(data11tumors2$Class, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- data11tumors2[split_index, ]
test_data <- data11tumors2[-split_index, ]
```



```{r}
# Perform hyperparameter tuning using tune.svm
tune_result <- tune.svm(
  x = X_train,
  y = as.factor(y_train),
  gamma = 2^(-3:3),  # Search range for gamma (RBF kernel)
  cost = 2^(-3:3),   # Search range for cost parameter (C)
  kernel = "radial",  # Use RBF kernel
  tunecontrol = tune.control(cross = 4)  # 5-fold cross-validation
)

# Best parameters
best_params <- tune_result$best.parameters
print(best_params)

# Train the SVM model with the best parameters
svm_model_tuned <- svm(
  x = X_train,
  y = as.factor(y_train),
  cost = best_params$cost,
  gamma = best_params$gamma,
  kernel = "radial",
  probability = TRUE
)

```


```{r}
model_untuned <- svm(x = X_train, y = as.factor(y_train), kernel = "linear", cost = 0.1, gamma = 0.125, scale = TRUE)
```

```{r}
preds_svm <- predict(model_untuned, X_test)

```

```{r}
library(caret)

# Make sure both preds and y_test are factors
confusion_matrix <- confusionMatrix(
  data = factor(preds_svm),
  reference = factor(y_test)
)

confusion_matrix

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(yardstick)

# First organize into a dataframe
svm_preds_df <- tibble(
  .pred_class = preds_svm,
  Class = y_test
)

# Create confusion matrix
svm_conf_mat <- confusion_matrix <- confusionMatrix(
  data = factor(preds_svm),
  reference = factor(y_test)
)



# Plot heatmap
# library(yardstick)

# 1. Fix Class factor levels to match predictions
svm_preds_df <- svm_preds_df %>%
  mutate(
    Class = factor(Class, levels = levels(.pred_class))
  )

# 2. Define the metrics you want
classification_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, sens, spec)

# 3. Compute the metrics
svm_sens_spec <- svm_preds_df %>%
  classification_metrics(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class)

svm_preds_df %>%
  classification_metrics(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class)


```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(yardstick)

# Step 1: Get predictions from your trained SVM model
# (Assumes you used: model_untuned or svm_model_tuned depending on your setup)
preds_svm <- predict(model_untuned, X_test)

# Step 2: Create a results dataframe
svm_preds_df <- tibble(
  .pred_class = preds_svm,
  Class = y_test
)

# Step 3: Ensure factor levels match
svm_preds_df <- svm_preds_df %>%
  mutate(
    Class = factor(Class),
    .pred_class = factor(.pred_class, levels = levels(Class))
  )

# Step 4: Compute metrics using yardstick
svm_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, sens, spec)(svm_preds_df, truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class)

# Step 5: Extract individual metrics
svm_accuracy <- svm_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "accuracy") %>% pull(.estimate)

# Step 6: Combine into a summary table
svm_summary <- tibble(
  Model = "SVM",
  Accuracy = svm_accuracy,
  Sensitivity = svm_sens,
  Specificity = svm_spec
)

# Step 7: View result
svm_summary

```

### KNN



```{r, message = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(recipes)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(glmnet)
library(FSelectorRcpp)


```

```{r}
tumors_df <- read_csv("../data/data11tumors2.csv")
```
#Training/Test Split
```{r}
set.seed(494)
split_index <- createDataPartition(tumors_df$Class, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- tumors_df[split_index, ]
test_data <- tumors_df[-split_index, ]
```

#Feature Selection
```{r}
#remove near-zero variance predictors
nzv <- nearZeroVar(train_data[, -1], saveMetrics = TRUE)
filtered_train <- train_data[, c(TRUE, !nzv$nzv)]
filtered_test <- test_data[, c(TRUE, !nzv$nzv)]

#Select top N features
set.seed(999)
info_gain <- information_gain(Class ~., data = filtered_train)
top_features <- info_gain %>%
  arrange(desc(importance)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100) %>% #take the 100 most informative genes
  pull(attributes)

train_selected <- filtered_train %>%
  select(all_of(c("Class", top_features)))

test_selected <- filtered_test %>%
  select(all_of(c("Class", top_features)))

#clarify that we know this is a classification task
train_selected$Class <- as.factor(train_selected$Class)
test_selected$Class <- as.factor(test_selected$Class)

#fix factor level names
levels(train_selected$Class) <- make.names(levels(train_selected$Class))
levels(test_selected$Class) <- make.names(levels(test_selected$Class))
```

#Preprocessing
```{r}
model_recipe <- recipe(Class ~., data = train_selected) %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors())

prepped_recipe <- prep(model_recipe, training = train_selected)
train_processed <- bake(prepped_recipe, new_data = train_selected)
test_processed <- bake(prepped_recipe, new_data = test_selected)
```

#KNN Tuning
```{r}
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 10,
  savePredictions = "final",
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = multiClassSummary
)

k_values <- data.frame(k = seq(1, 21, by = 2))
```

#Train model
```{r, warning = FALSE}
library(MLmetrics)
set.seed(494)
knn_model <- train(
  x = train_processed %>% select(-Class),
  y = train_processed$Class,
  method = "knn",
  trControl = train_control,
  tuneGrid = k_values,
  metric = "Accuracy"
)
print(knn_model)
```

#Eval on test set
```{r}
test_predictions <- predict(knn_model, newdata = test_processed %>% select(-Class))
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(test_predictions, test_processed$Class)
print(conf_matrix)
results_df <- data.frame(
  Actual = test_selected$Class,
  Predicted = test_predictions
)
```



```{r}
library(yardstick)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Ensure matching factor levels
results_df2 <- results_df %>%
  mutate(
    Actual = factor(Actual),
    Predicted = factor(Predicted, levels = levels(Actual))
  )

# 2. Define classification metric set
classification_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, sens, spec)

# 3. Compute accuracy, sensitivity, specificity
knn_metrics <- classification_metrics(results_df2, truth = Actual, estimate = Predicted)

# 4. Extract individual metrics
knn_accuracy <- knn_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "accuracy") %>% pull(.estimate)
knn_sens     <- knn_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "sens")     %>% pull(.estimate)
knn_spec     <- knn_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "spec")     %>% pull(.estimate)

# 5. Create tidy summary
knn_summary <- tibble(
  Model = "KNN",
  Accuracy = knn_accuracy,
  Sensitivity = knn_sens,
  Specificity = knn_spec
)

# View summary
knn_summary



```

```{r}
knn_sens_spec <- data.frame(
  Overall_Sensitivity = overall_sensitivity,
  Overall_Specificity = overall_specificity
)

```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(yardstick)

# Step 1: Generate predictions from KNN model
test_predictions <- predict(knn_model, newdata = test_processed %>% select(-Class))

# Step 2: Create a results dataframe
results_df <- data.frame(
  Actual = test_selected$Class,
  Predicted = test_predictions
)

# Step 3: Ensure factor levels match
results_df2 <- results_df %>%
  mutate(
    Actual = factor(Actual),
    Predicted = factor(Predicted, levels = levels(Actual))
  )

# Step 4: Compute metrics using yardstick
knn_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, sens, spec)(results_df2, truth = Actual, estimate = Predicted)

# Step 5: Extract individual metrics
knn_accuracy <- knn_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "accuracy") %>% pull(.estimate)
knn_sens     <- knn_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "sens")     %>% pull(.estimate)
knn_spec     <- knn_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "spec")     %>% pull(.estimate)

# Step 6: Combine into a summary table
knn_summary <- tibble(
  Model = "KNN",
  Accuracy = knn_accuracy,
  Sensitivity = knn_sens,
  Specificity = knn_spec
)

# Step 7: View results
knn_summary

```

### PCA


```{r, message = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(recipes)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(glmnet)
library(FSelectorRcpp)
```



#Training/Test Split
```{r}
set.seed(687)
#split_index <- createDataPartition(tumors_df$Class, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
#train_data <- tumors_df[split_index, ]
#test_data <- tumors_df[-split_index, ]

tumors_train <- read_csv("/Users/noahshannon/Desktop/Classes/STAT Gen/Presentation/train.csv")
tumors_test <- read_csv("/Users/noahshannon/Desktop/Classes/STAT Gen/Presentation/test.csv")
```

#Feature Selection
```{r}
#remove near-zero variance predictors
nzv <- nearZeroVar(train_data[, -1], saveMetrics = TRUE)
filtered_train <- train_data[, c(TRUE, !nzv$nzv)]
filtered_test <- test_data[, c(TRUE, !nzv$nzv)]

#Select top N features
set.seed(999)
info_gain <- information_gain(Class ~., data = filtered_train)
top_features <- info_gain %>%
  arrange(desc(importance)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100) %>% #take the 100 most informative genes
  pull(attributes)

train_selected <- filtered_train %>%
  select(all_of(c("Class", top_features)))

test_selected <- filtered_test %>%
  select(all_of(c("Class", top_features)))

#clarify that we know this is a classification task
train_selected$Class <- as.factor(train_selected$Class)
test_selected$Class <- as.factor(test_selected$Class)

#fix factor level names
levels(train_selected$Class) <- make.names(levels(train_selected$Class))
levels(test_selected$Class) <- make.names(levels(test_selected$Class))
```

#Preprocessing
```{r}
model_recipe <- recipe(Class ~., data = train_selected) %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors())

prepped_recipe <- prep(model_recipe, training = train_selected)
train_processed <- bake(prepped_recipe, new_data = train_selected)
test_processed <- bake(prepped_recipe, new_data = test_selected)
```

#KNN Tuning
```{r}
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 10,
  savePredictions = "final",
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = multiClassSummary
)

k_values <- data.frame(k = seq(1, 21, by = 2))
```

#Train model
```{r, warning = FALSE}
library(MLmetrics)
set.seed(789)
knn_model <- train(
  x = train_processed %>% select(-Class),
  y = train_processed$Class,
  method = "knn",
  trControl = train_control,
  tuneGrid = k_values,
  metric = "Accuracy"
)
print(knn_model)
```

#Eval on test set
```{r}
test_predictions <- predict(knn_model, newdata = test_processed %>% select(-Class))
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(test_predictions, test_processed$Class)
print(conf_matrix)
knn_results_df <- data.frame(
  Actual = test_selected$Class,
  Predicted = test_predictions
)
```


#Accuracy by Class
```{r}
accuracy_by_class <- knn_results_df %>%
  group_by(Actual) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    Total = n(),
    Correct = sum(as.character(Actual) == as.character(Predicted)),
    Accuracy = Correct / Total
  )

ggplot(accuracy_by_class, aes(x = Actual, y = Accuracy, fill = Actual)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(Accuracy)), vjust = -0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Accuracy by Tumor Class", y = "Accuracy", x = "Tumor Class") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1))

```

#Error Rate vs K
```{r}
tuning_plot <- ggplot(knn_model) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = knn_model$results$k) +
  labs(title = "KNN Model Accuracy by k Value", x = "Number of Neighbors", y = "Accuracy")

print(tuning_plot)

```

#PCA Preprocessing
```{r}
#retain PCs that explain 95% of the variance
pca_recipe <- recipe(Class ~ ., data = filtered_train) %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_pca(all_predictors(), threshold = 0.95)

pca_prep <- prep(pca_recipe, training = filtered_train)
train_pca <- bake(pca_prep, new_data = filtered_train)
test_pca <- bake(pca_prep, new_data = filtered_test)

#convert outcome --> factor + fix level names
train_pca$Class <- as.factor(train_pca$Class)
test_pca$Class <- as.factor(test_pca$Class)
levels(train_pca$Class) <- make.names(levels(train_pca$Class))
levels(test_pca$Class) <- make.names(levels(test_pca$Class))

```

#Train PCA-based model
```{r, warning = FALSE}
set.seed(789)
knn_pca_model <- train(
  x = train_pca %>% select(-Class),
  y = train_pca$Class,
  method = "knn",
  trControl = train_control,
  tuneGrid = k_values,
  metric = "Accuracy"
)
print(knn_pca_model)
```

#Eval on test set
```{r}
pca_predictions <- predict(knn_pca_model, newdata = test_pca %>% select(-Class))
pca_predictions <- factor(pca_predictions, levels = levels(test_pca$Class))
pca_conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(pca_predictions, test_pca$Class)
print(pca_conf_matrix)

pca_results_df <- data.frame(
  Actual = test_pca$Class,
  Predicted = pca_predictions
)
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(yardstick)

# Step 1: Create prediction dataframe
pca_results_df <- data.frame(
  Actual = test_pca$Class,
  Predicted = predict(knn_pca_model, newdata = test_pca %>% select(-Class))
)

# Step 2: Ensure factor levels match
pca_results_df <- pca_results_df %>%
  mutate(
    Actual = factor(Actual),
    Predicted = factor(Predicted, levels = levels(Actual))
  )

# Step 3: Define metric set
classification_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, sens, spec)

# Step 4: Compute metrics
pca_metrics <- classification_metrics(pca_results_df, truth = Actual, estimate = Predicted)

# Step 5: Extract individual metrics
pca_accuracy <- pca_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "accuracy") %>% pull(.estimate)
pca_sens     <- pca_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "sens")     %>% pull(.estimate)
pca_spec     <- pca_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "spec")     %>% pull(.estimate)

# Step 6: Combine into summary tibble
pca_summary <- tibble(
  Model = "KNN (PCA)",
  Accuracy = pca_accuracy,
  Sensitivity = pca_sens,
  Specificity = pca_spec
)

# Step 7: View result
pca_summary

```

```{r}
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)

# Existing model summaries
all_model_summary <- tribble(
  ~Model,     ~Accuracy, ~Sensitivity, ~Specificity,
  "KNN",       0.9333333, 0.8958333,    0.9919165,
  "SVM",       0.8857143, 0.8750000,    0.9878676,

)

# Add KNN (PCA) row from earlier yardstick output
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

library(dplyr)

  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +

    x = "Model",
    y = "Value",
    fill = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

```
